bundle.shortDescription: Why is my development PC slow? DevPilot tells you, and what to do about it.
bundle.longDescription: DevPilot is a lightweight Windows system health assistant for developers. It monitors RAM, CPU and disks, groups Docker/WSL2, Android/Gradle, Node.js and other workloads, explains what is causing resource pressure, and offers safe, previewed fixes. Works fully offline; AI assistance is optional.
